Scripsit librum de iustificatione, Gaspar
Contarenus Cardinalis vir doctus, & pius,
postquam iam Lutherus, aliique suam sententiam
de hac re declarassent. Quo libro testatur,
Protestantes & Catholicos in hac re conveni-
re. Recte Contarenus, qui, quum ex industria Protestantium doctrinam examinasset, nihil

At in sententia de iustificatione non convenit Protestantibus
cum Concilio Tridentino, non igitur
erat illud Concilium conventus Catholicorum. Et
quia Catholicorum sententiam de iustificatione
Contarenus eo libro explicandam

page.notes: Right page is only the edge of the neighbouring page and was not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "Si solum" (word spacing and long s unclear); "suius" (possibly "fuius" or "eiusdem" in the printed text, first letter unclear); running head "IVSTIFICANTE" (last letters partly obscured by a blotch). "iustificāte" has a macron over the a as printed. Catchword "isti," stands at the right below the last line.
